'''Lexa Tcheil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] who served within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] just before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She was among a group of Initiates that were training under [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] until [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered the classroom and asked for Yoda's help in searching for [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].
